## Analysis Methodology

   - Full library analysis with all protocols
   - Cross-reference listing
   - Graphviz dot format output for visualization

  - `operate()` - Main operation handler
  - `globalconf_free()` - Cleanup

  - `Curl_creader_create()` / `Curl_cwriter_create()` - I/O filter chain

```
